title: Delivery, observability, and final capstone — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: Operate a secure expense API as a small production-style service.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Where should production secrets be supplied?
questions.explanation: Keep credentials out of source and public artifacts.

options.text: Whether the instance should receive traffic
Whether every dependency will never fail

questions.explanation: Readiness supports traffic routing during startup and degraded states.

questions.prompt: What is a useful purpose of a correlation id?
questions.explanation: Correlation supports investigation but is not access control or deduplication.

options.text: Stop new work and allow bounded completion of in-flight work
Kill all requests without notice every time

questions.explanation: A bounded lifecycle reduces avoidable interruption and resource leaks.

options.text: A backup is useful only if it can be restored correctly

questions.explanation: Recovery must be verified with the actual procedure.

questions.prompt: Which metric better exposes slow tail requests than an average alone?

options.text: A latency percentile such as p95

questions.explanation: Percentiles reveal distribution tails hidden by an average.
A request identifier ties safe operational events together. The event contains an operation name, not a token or full personal payload. The displayed request id can be used to locate related logs.
